author: _Downcast
body:
Age: 15

Timezone: United Kingdom (U.K)

Previous team/tournament experience: At times I have participated in scrims and have done well (according to my teamates). Although I have not participated in any tournaments, I would love to have the opportunity to experiece a tournament environment. 

Why should you consider me:  My PVP skills have extremely increased (much like my bow skills) and my  awareness is far beyond average.

Preffered Position: Midline/Rusher - I believe that this is the most adequate possition for me because throughout games I am determined to succeed in games.

EXTRA INFORMARTION: I speak both fluent English and Spanish, if needed I would be more tan happy to translate for players in our team who don´t speak both the languages.

(Spanish)

También estaría dispuesta a estar en un equipo español.
